name: hot-mess-hq
description: Connects your Claude to your private Hot Mess HQ page and runs its background jobs: requests you send from the page, the inbox sweep, the morning weather, video edits, animated carousels, your business numbers at a glance your recipes and grocery cart, who is waiting on a reply from you, your Brand Brain and what you have told it to remember (your colors, logo and voice on everything Claude makes).
